title: Fix blank PC Lab page
summary: Removed invalid raw CSS appended outside the computer lab style string, which caused the embedded PC Lab document to fail parsing and render blank.

changes.detail: Moved the accidental standalone CSS out of the TypeScript module so pcExplorerDocument can compile and render again.
Retained double-click component inspection and reveal-underneath controls in the valid generated document.

validation.detail: The visible browser route was not reloaded from this session; no deployment.
